invariants.rationale: Compaction operations typically require a non-null instant identifier.
The method requires a valid engine context for any operation.
Presence of extraMetadata Option object is required for code correctness, even if it's Option.empty().
The instant time should be a non-empty String as it represents a commit or operation moment.
Option<T> is always either present or not present, making this mutually exhaustive for the Option type.
